description: This file defines a Supabase client for data access in a frontend application, with authentication flows disabled. It exports a 'supabase' client object that either connects to a Supabase backend using environment variables or provides stub functions for unauthenticated or unconfigured usage.

methods.name: getSession
methods.description: Returns a mock session object, indicating no active session.

methods.name: onAuthStateChange
methods.description: Returns a mock subscription object with a no-op 'unsubscribe' method.

methods.name: signInWithPassword
methods.description: Returns an error indicating Supabase is not configured.

methods.name: signOut
methods.description: Returns an error indicating Supabase is not configured.
